Adoption of Code

  1. There is adopted the Spokane Municipal Code, consisting of sixteen numbered titles, as revised through December 11, 2000.
     
  2. There is included within the printed code the Charter of the City of Spokane as amended by the general election of November 7, 2000.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
